name: Brakka Mourn
seed: Raiding captain who equates fear with respect. Runs with Dreg and Vessa; spends resources on demonstrations of strength.
design: Female wolverine, dark umber coat, pale forehead streak, battered red shoulder wrap and functional hooked staff.
history: Born in Cinder Cuts before freight decline. Began as a convoy guard, learned that fear brought faster payment, and built a raiding crew seven years ago.
desire: To make every neighboring route pay tribute and never again be dismissed as expendable labor.
contradiction: Calls fear respect and wastes the food she claims to protect on displays of dominance.
relationships: Dreg supplies; Vessa scouts; Serik is an unreliable distant buyer; workers in her home district mostly want her gone.
arc: Loses a raid because her crew protects supplies rather than her spectacle. Later doubles down or faces a humiliating survival that requires accepting mercy.
story_engine: A feast funded by theft; a subordinate discovers that her invulnerable legend began as a frightened accident.
writer_truth: No one secretly appointed her guardian of the Cinder Cuts. Her hardship explains her anger, not her entitlement.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
